text_segments.text: STATUS at 2400 Hrs: Pressure test casing and WH, rig down
Continue to clean cellar, nipple up tubing head.
Nipple up tubing head, clean around cellar.
Hand-over, safety meeting pre-pressure test casing.
Pressure test casing and well-head to 4,280psi (test good), bled off, secure abandonment flange on top of THH, Close all
well-head valves. (valve handles are to be removed).
Rig down and prep equipment for move.
Rig down and continue move to Lamont Pass 3
No incidents or accidents to report.
Rigging down, preparing to move to Lamont Pass 3
Nipple up tubing head, pressure test THH and casing
Continue rig down, move to Lamont Pass 3
Thursday, 3 October 2013 Rig Down, start moving equipment to Lamont Pass 3.
Saturday, 5 October 2013 Drill conductor hole, cement in place
Sunday, 6 October 2013 Drill out and drill ahead.
